$comment: Language-neutral conformance cases against the bundled catalog. Every binding (Rust, the C ABI, Node, .NET) must produce the same `expect` for each case from resolveToolRequirementsWithDiagnostics(tools, context), and resolveToolRequirements must return `expect.requirements` (absent when no requirements are resolved). `expectError` cases must fail with that code and reason. Expectations are recorded with `MXC_POLICY_STORE_UPDATE_FIXTURES=<dir> cargo test -p mxc-sdk --test policy_store_conformance` and reviewed by hand. An optional `host` describes the fixed test host (platform, nativeArchitecture, symbols, discovered, aliases, unknownPaths); bindings that run on the real host skip cases that set host facts other than platform and architecture.
